answer: Each identity stakes 70 credits on the juniper beacon roll: each epoch one in eight is re-checked. Between draws each runs a heartbeat thread of sequential hashes, one a minute per live machine. The drawn agent must produce the next hash in 60 seconds against a quartz clock; a missed beat or rented heartbeat burns the bond. First fake 45, k-th 45+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 4,041,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep the bond.
